title: Digital products and delivery boundaries

journeys.title: Sell digital goods without physical inventory
journeys.fixture: Digital SKU D; three licences@200; no tax; no delivery assumption.

cases.title: Digital invoice
cases.given: No physical stock; bank0.
cases.expected: AR600/revenue600 under applicable completed-sale policy; no physical quantity, asset or COGS movements.

cases.title: Digital purchase
cases.given: Vendor software100 classified as expense under reviewed policy.
cases.expected: No physical stock; approved expense/intangible treatment required; cannot infer intangible capitalization from digital label.

cases.title: Wrong classification
cases.given: Stored SKU says physical though name says digital.
cases.expected: Fixture invalid; stop/reclassify through supported flow and preserve first attempt; product name is not class evidence.

cases.title: Sale with empty product ID
cases.given: Description-only digital service line allowed by contract.
cases.expected: No foreign/unknown SKU silently treated as free text; legitimate free-text applicability verified; no stock.

cases.title: Return or credit
cases.given: Digital sale paid600; policy permits one licence credit200.
cases.expected: Net revenue400; customer credit200 until refund; no invented physical return200 or quantity1.

journeys.title: Delivery, licence, download and revocation contract
journeys.fixture: Completed digital invoice exists; entitlement capability not assumed from schema.
policyGaps: No separate delivery/entitlement implementation was established in this source study. Cases are capability-conditional, not runnable pass claims.

cases.title: Inspect entitlement support
cases.given: Invoice600 posted.
cases.action: Find supported delivery/licence state and official business contract.
cases.expected: Record actual capability evidence or unsupported gap. Invoice/print is not delivery proof.

cases.title: Authorized delivery target
cases.given: If supported: licence L for party C, not C2.
cases.expected: Only C receives declared scope/expiry; recipient identity and issuance linked; exactly one accepted entitlement.

cases.title: Retry issuing same licence
cases.given: If supported: delivery succeeded before timeout.
cases.expected: No duplicate paid entitlement or repeated charge; recover existing delivery state.

cases.title: Refund and revocation
cases.given: If supported: refunded licence has an access contract.
cases.expected: Access follows reviewed revocation/expiry policy; payment reversal alone is not observed access revocation.

cases.title: Foreign or expired access
cases.given: If supported: real foreign entitlement and expired fixture.
cases.action: Request both with own valid positive control.
cases.expected: Foreign/expired access denied without leaking other recipient data; authorized current access works.

journeys.title: Digital refunds, quantity and historical price
journeys.fixture: Digital licence SKU price200; invoice3x200; paid600.

cases.title: Partial credit one licence
cases.given: Original3 paid600; no prior credit.
cases.expected: Credit200; net revenue400; bank600 until refund; returnable quantity2 if quantity-based credits supported.

cases.title: Refund once
cases.given: Credit200 available.
cases.expected: Bank400; credit balance0; original600 receipt retained; no inventory.

cases.title: Excess credit
cases.given: Original3, already credited1.
cases.expected: Deny beyond remaining2/value400; no cash or entitlement side effects.

cases.title: Price changes
cases.given: Original unit200; current master250.
cases.expected: Original print600; source credit200, not250; master can price new sales separately.

cases.title: Entitlement refund consistency
cases.given: Delivery capability conditional.
cases.expected: Record separate entitlement and financial outcomes; do not call full workflow accepted while access disposition is unknown.

journeys.title: Digital classification, tax and mixed bundles
journeys.fixture: Digital100 plus physical300 at cost180; no VAT baseline; bundle capabilities explicit.
policyGaps: Bundle entitlement allocation and mixed tax require separately verified support; numerical discount example is delegated policy, not legal advice.

cases.title: Mixed invoice
cases.given: Physical stock10; digital unstocked.
cases.expected: Revenue400; COGS180 only physical; physical stock decreases declared units; digital has no movement; profit220.

cases.title: Bundle discount
cases.given: Physical300+digital100, header discount40.
cases.expected: Physical net270/digital90; total360; COGS180 unchanged; later physical credit uses270 source share.

cases.title: Mixed tax classifications
cases.given: One taxable and one exempt line.
cases.expected: Use reviewed per-line buckets or explicit unsupported refusal; single-rate total cannot pass mixed-tax acceptance.

cases.title: Module disabled
cases.given: Sales disabled but cached digital invoice form open.
cases.expected: Server denies; no posted document, payment or invented entitlement.

cases.title: Digital description HTML
cases.given: Inert HTML-like title stored in fixture.
cases.expected: Content remains harmless text or sanitized approved content; no executable markup or spreadsheet formula behavior.

author: independent-QA-agent
moneyConvention: LKR, two decimal places; numerical examples in rupees unless oracle label says cents
